Training is explicitly adapted to Modern 4e proficiency (+5 in the baseline engine). Choice uses the current 16 skills, including new Crafting (Intelligence), Medicine (Intelligence), Society (Intelligence), Nature and Wisdom-based Religion.

Repeat selection and distinct chosen-skill constraints are not expressible in v1 mechanics.
